message.text: The dispatch function and internal/webhook package were located. Now examining the webhook package to identify the signing mechanism.

The CreateMemo handler calls `DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook` in `memo_service.go`, implemented in `memo_service_webhooks.go`.

It invokes `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook`, which calls `webhook.PostAsync` from `internal/webhook`. The signing mechanism is Standard Webhooks HMAC-SHA256 with v1 signature headers and `whsec_` secrets.

q22.
DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook — server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go; internal/webhook; Standard Webhooks HMAC-SHA256 (`webhook-signature: v1,…`)

`CreateMemo` in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go` calls that dispatcher, which loads the creator’s webhooks and `webhook.PostAsync`. Delivery is in `internal/webhook/webhook.go`: POST JSON, signed with HMAC-SHA256 over `msgID.timestamp.body` using a `whsec_` secret.
